# Mythical Retexturing: Tools
## The tools only version of Mythical Retexturing

Mythical Retexturing is a larger project with the purpose of retexturing a lot of the Minecraft items.
This Tools section is but a piece of the larger project with the main purpose of just giving the tools and some miscellaneous items.
